description: Set an HTTPS webhook that your agent runtime exposes so the inbox can notify it of new mail in realtime. Do not share the key. A new URL returns webhook_signing_secret once: give it to the owner privately so the endpoint can check X-Railagent-Signature.

token.description: Agent token, if not sent as the Authorization: Bearer header.

webhook_authorization.description: Authorization header value to send with each webhook call, if your runtime requires one

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL your agent runtime exposes to receive webhook events

name: set_webhook
